avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce thalidomide levels and efficacy; also increases photosensitivity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid completely and inform provider of use

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive thrombotic risk; thalidomide is teratogenic with increased DVT/PE risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E supplementation; doses >400 IU/day require provider approval and DVT prophylaxis assessment

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects may compound thalidomide-associated thromboembolism risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only with explicit provider approval and monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Thalidomide commonly causes peripheral neuropathy; B6 may help mitigate neuropathic symptoms
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for neuropathy; supplementation may be beneficial but requires provider coordination

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May provide antioxidant support; no direct interaction but used for fatigue management in cancer patients
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe; encourage provider awareness for comprehensive monitoring

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (>30g fat)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increased fat intake can significantly elevate thalidomide absorption and serum levels, increasing toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Take thalidomide with consistent low-fat meals; counsel on dietary consistency to maintain stable levels

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase thalidomide exposure; effect is typically mild with thalidomide
caution_foods.action: Occasional consumption acceptable; advise consistent intake patterns and provider awareness

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and increased peripheral neuropathy risk; thalidomide causes dizziness/somnolence
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol; counsel on cumulative neuropathy risk and fall prevention

monitoring_notes: Thalidomide has critical teratogenicity (Category X) requiring strict REMS compliance; monitor for peripheral neuropathy, thromboembolism (DVT/PE prophylaxis often needed), and cytopenias independent of supplement interactions. Counsel on absolute dietary consistency given fat-dependent absorption and maintain close communication regarding any supplements or dietary changes.
